Released worktree for parent validation.

Changed five files. Removed the standalone CLI command and restricted its remaining test helper to `cfg(test)`. Deployment and verification docs now use an exact declaration-load retry, require unchanged artifacts, and explain that new loads can replace source data.

Formatting and diff checks pass. No runtime suites run. `todo.md` remains untracked. No commit made.

Existing root README wording says exact retries leave the database unchanged. That overlooks projection refresh and merits a small correction.
